name: B10-0104/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Nigeria to free Yahaya Sharif-Aminu, a singer sentenced to death in 2020 over a song a Sharia court judged blasphemous. It wants his conviction dropped, better treatment in prison, and access to his family and lawyer. It also asks Nigeria to scrap blasphemy laws carrying the death penalty, stop executions, and protect people accused of blasphemy from violent mobs. The Parliament is not making law here; it is stating its position and pressing Nigerian authorities to act.

- Nothing changes in law yet; the Parliament only calls on Nigeria to release Sharif-Aminu and repeal blasphemy laws.
- The demands affect Sharif-Aminu, other people accused of blasphemy in Nigeria, and Nigerian courts and state authorities.
- Next, the Parliament asks the European Commission and Member States to raise the case with Nigeria and watch his Supreme Court appeal.
